_meta.source: PRC Professional Regulatory Board of Veterinary Medicine, Annex 'A' to Resolution No. 07 s.2024: Enhanced Tables of Specifications for the Subjects in the Veterinarian Licensure Examination (user-provided PDF). Implemented from the October 2024 VLE onward.
_meta.checks: Every subject's competency items sum to 100; every parent topic equals the sum of its sub-items; Bloom totals sum to 100 per subject; exam weights sum to 100.
_meta.howToUse: 'items' = number of questions out of 100 per subject exam; section weight = % of that subject. Overall share of a competency in the whole exam = items/100 x examWeightPct.
_meta.bloom: R Remembering, U Understanding, Ap Applying, An Analyzing, E Evaluating, C Creating. Totals are copied as printed; the per-row column alignment in the PDF scan was unreliable, so row-level levels are not recorded.
printedOddities: Veterinary Medicine H.3 prints 'RA 8585' (Animal Welfare Act is RA 8485 as amended by RA 10631; verify)
